output.summary: An annual or short-lived perennial found across tropical and subtropical parts of several continents, it commonly grows in gardens, fields, roadsides and disturbed ground. Its daisy-like flower heads have tiny yellow centres and may have white or cream outer petals; young leaves can be eaten as salad, while fresh or dried leaves are also boiled.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves may be eaten as salad; fresh or dried leaves are boiled. Older leaves may taste unpleasant and upset the stomach.
